scope: every (n, k, S_k gate) class of distance-3 factory with n <= 48 injections at every covered check rank: the shipped n <= 40 table followed by the n = 41 .. 48 one
open_sector: n = 47, 48 from the unique affine-rank-6 weight-48 word (RM(3,7) class 3470, a+abc): check rank 6 at n = 47 and 48, and its rank-7 lift at n = 48.  Not swept: kappa = 20, 21, frames up to width 15 possible.  See docs/OPEN_RANK6.md.
dedup_key: S_k: output permutations only (GL(k,2) is coarser and not used)
a3: a3: number of 3-sets of injections that pass every check and act on the outputs; the leading coefficient of the logical error rate, P_fail ~ a3 p^3
